      Checks if AI verdict was just assigned (previously undefined) to identify newly analyzed signals.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Set_Case_Status_To_New

        $:and:

    delay: 0

        type: Incident

        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
      applicationName: ""
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
    recordActionType: patch
    inputSchemaReferenceId: a81ada7a-7f86-41bb-a075-c196f6e98348
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  CASE_Escalation_Conditions:
    meta: {}
    title: CASE Escalation Conditions
    type: conditional
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Evaluates if AI verdict is Malicious or Suspicious with confidence ≥8 to determine escalation path.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: eeafe1e0-8ea5-4c8a-b65d-fd6c5a7b71c1
    conditions:
    - action: Set_Requires_Attention_True
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['ai-verdict-confidence']
          - $:gte:
              $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_General_Configuration. Confidence_Thresholds.Malicious_Suspicious
        - $:or:
          - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['ai-verdict']
            - $:eq: Malicious
            - ignoreCase: false
          - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['ai-verdict']
            - $:eq: Suspicious
            - ignoreCase: false
    else: CASE_Closure_Conditions
    disabled: false
  CASE_Closure_Conditions:
    meta: {}
    title: CASE Closure Conditions
    type: conditional
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Checks if AI verdict is Benign with confidence ≥8 to determine if signal should be closed.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 85341175-556d-4880-a547-f7e31e406d8d
    conditions:
    - action: Close_CASE_Record
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['ai-verdict-confidence']
          - $:gte:
              $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_General_Configuration. Confidence_Thresholds.Benign
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['ai-verdict']
          - $:eq: Benign
          - ignoreCase: false
    else: AI_Verdict_Just_Defined
    disabled: false
  Close_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Close CASE Record
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Update_CASE_Timeline: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Closes the CASE record with status "Closed" and classification "False Positive".
    inputSchemaReferenceId: b35e57e8-c616-4ab4-8e78-2ae0f15229d4
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        status: Closed
        auto-closed-by-hero-ai: "True"
        time-assigned: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['analysis-agent-start-time'] }"
        initiate-error-recovery: "False"
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: patch
  Update_CASE_Timeline:
    meta: {}
    title: Update CASE Timeline

    pool: $default
    on-success: []

    on-complete: []

    post: {}

    description: >

    action: $playbook.component_aXlYrqnbr1i_dcEii_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      Tracking_ID: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      Title: CASE Closed Due To Verdict And Confidence
      Playbook_Name: Pending Signal Resolution
      Details: This CASE has a high confidence Verdict of Benign.
    testInputs: {}
  Update_CASE_Timeline_Attn:

    type: connector
    description: ""

    action: $playbook.component_aXlYrqnbr1i_dcEii_playbook
    inputs:

      Details: "This CASE has a high confidence Verdict of { $:ref: $event.data.record.values['ai-verdict'] }."

    meta: {}
    delay: 0

    timeout: 0
    asset: ""

    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []

    timeout: 0

    inputSchemaReferenceId: 7e033dc9-d0a6-4293-af0d-14fcd12689d1

        groups:

    conditions:
    - action: Set_Status_Escalated
      condition:
        $:and:
        - $:or:
          - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values.status
            - $:eq: Processing
            - ignoreCase: false
          - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values.status
            - $:eq: New
            - ignoreCase: false
          - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values.status
            - $:eq: Error
            - ignoreCase: false
    else: ""
    disabled: false
  Set_Status_Escalated:
    meta: {}
    title: Set Status Escalated
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: a059b05a-dcfe-4c09-9fcb-87dbbb05debf
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        status: Escalated
        initiate-error-recovery: "False"
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: patch
  Check_if_the_Status_was_Error_State:
    meta: {}
    title: Check if the Status was Error State
    type: conditional
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: ""
    conditions:
    - action: Set_Case_Status_From_Error_To_New
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values.status
          - $:match: Error
          - ignoreCase: false
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['ai-verdict']
          - $:def: true
        - - $:ref: $event.data.previous.values['ai-verdict-confidence']
          - $:def: true
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['correlation-status']
          - $:def: true
        - - $:ref: $event.data.record.values['threat-intelligence-status']
          - $:def: true
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: fe5fd4c7-86e2-4cde-bb47-a737300bf342
